jobs.title: Oracle ERP Developer
jobs.description:
Oracle ERP Developer 
Location -Local to Warren, NJ 
 
Role Overview
The Oracle ERP Developer is responsible for designing, developing, and supporting technical solutions across Oracle ERP Cloud applications. The role focuses on integrations, reporting, data conversions, and extensions using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher, and PL/SQL. The developer works closely with functional teams to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions and ensure seamless data flow across modules and external systems.
 
Key Responsibilities

Develop, maintain, and optimize integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including REST/SOAP services, file-based integrations, orchestration flows, and connectivity with external systems.
Build and enhance BI Publisher reports, data models, bursting logic, and scheduled report delivery.
Write efficient PL/SQL packages, procedures, functions, and scripts to support data transformations, validations, and backend processes.
Utilize BICC (BI Cloud Connector) for bulk data extraction, data migration, and integration with downstream systems.
Design and execute FBDI and ADFdi templates for data conversions, mass updates, and ongoing data loads.
Support and troubleshoot issues across integrations, reports, and extensions in Oracle ERP Cloud.
Collaborate with functional teams to understand business processes and translate them into technical specifications.
Develop and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, integration specs, data mapping, and test scripts.
Ensure solutions follow Oracle best practices, security standards, and performance guidelines.
Participate in release cycles, regression testing, and deployment activities.
Provide production support, root‑cause analysis, and performance tuning for integrations and reports.

 
 

Required Skills and Experience

Hands‑on experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), including Integration, Process, and third-party connections with REST and SOAP web services, API integrations, and authentication methods (OAuth, Basic Auth).
Strong expertise in BI Publisher (data models, RTF / XSLT templates, bursting, scheduling).
Advanced PL/SQL development skills, including performance tuning and complex data processing.
Familiarity with BICC for large‑scale data extraction.
Experience with FBDI and ADFdi for data loads and mass updates.
Strong understanding of Oracle ERP Cloud modules (Financials GL, AHUB, AP, CM, FA, PO).
Ability to analyze logs, troubleshoot integration failures, and resolve technical issues quickly.

 
Preferred / Nice‑to‑Have Skills

Experience with OCI Data Integration (OCI‑DI) or other OCI services (Object Storage, Functions, API Gateway).
Proficiency in OTBI reporting and subject area customization.
Understanding of Oracle Cloud security, roles, and privileges.
Exposure to PaaS extensions, custom REST endpoints, and Oracle Autonomous Database.
Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps practices.
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and deployment automation.
Oracle Cloud certifications are a plus (OIC, ERP Cloud, OCI).

 
Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem‑solving abilities.
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Ability to work cross‑functionally with business and technical teams.
Self‑driven, detail‑oriented, and comfortable working in fast‑paced environments.

Location: Malvern, PA

The ideal candidate should be a hands-on backend engineer who can design, build, and support resilient, scalable, and fault-tolerant applications in a cloud environment.

Strong understanding of production reliability, scalability, and system performance.

jobs.title: Oracle EPCM Consultant
jobs.description:
#w2 Role
 
Job Description
We are seeking an experienced Oracle EPCM Consultant to support design, implementation, and enhancement of Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management solutions. This role will focus on building and maintaining profitability models, allocation rules, driver-based calculations, reporting structures, and financial analysis capabilities within Oracle EPCM.
The consultant will work with Finance, FP&A, Accounting, and IT teams to understand business allocation requirements and translate them into scalable Oracle EPCM solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience with Oracle Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management Cloud, allocation models, calculation rules, financial reporting, and EPM Cloud integrations.
Key Responsibilities
•    Lead design, configuration, and support of Oracle EPCM Cloud solutions.
•    Build and maintain profitability and cost allocation models.
•    Configure allocation rules, rule sets, calculation logic, drivers, POVs, dimensions, and model structures.
•    Work with Finance and FP&A teams to gather business requirements for cost allocation, profitability analysis, and management reporting.
•    Support data integration between EPCM and source systems such as Oracle ERP Cloud, EPM Planning, FCCS, Essbase, or data warehouses.
•    Develop and validate allocation results, calculation outputs, and financial reports.
•    Support month-end and quarter-end profitability processing activities.
•    Troubleshoot calculation errors, data load issues, performance concerns, and reporting discrepancies.
•    Assist with testing, UAT, deployment, documentation, and production support.
•    Recommend best practices for model optimization, automation, and process improvement.
•    Travel to client site approximately once every 3 months for key workshops, planning sessions, or milestone activities.
Required Skills
•    8+ years of experience in Oracle EPM / Hyperion applications.
•    5+ years of experience with profitability, cost allocation, or management reporting solutions.
•    Strong hands-on experience with Oracle EPCM / PCMCS / Enterprise Profitability and Cost Management Cloud.
•    Experience designing allocation models, calculation rules, rule sets, drivers, and profitability reporting.
•    Strong understanding of financial planning, cost allocation, profitability analysis, management reporting, and accounting concepts.
•    Experience with Oracle EPM Cloud components such as Planning, FCCS, Essbase, Data Integration, Smart View, and Financial Reporting.
•    Ability to analyze business requirements and convert them into EPCM design and configuration.
•    Strong data validation, reconciliation, troubleshooting, and performance tuning skills.
•    Excellent communication skills with the ability to work directly with Finance and IT stakeholders.
Preferred Skills
•    Experience with Oracle Cloud ERP financials.
•    Knowledge of EPM Automate, REST APIs, Groovy, or automation scripts.
•    Experience migrating from Hyperion Profitability and Cost Management or PCMCS to EPCM.
•    Experience supporting financial transformation or enterprise performance management projects.
•    Strong documentation and client-facing consulting experience.

The consultant will work closely with Finance, Accounting, FP&A, IT, and business teams to manage hierarchies, dimensions, mappings, approvals, and metadata changes within Oracle Enterprise Data Management Cloud Service.
The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in Oracle EDMCS / EDM, EPM metadata management, governance workflows, data validation, and integration with downstream applications such as Planning, FCCS, ARCS, EPBCS, ERP, or reporting platforms.

•    Support design, configuration, and administration of Oracle EDMCS / EDM Cloud.
•    Manage enterprise dimensions, hierarchies, node types, viewpoints, applications, and subscriptions.
•    Build and maintain data governance workflows, approval processes, and change request models.
•    Work with Finance and business users to gather metadata requirements and convert them into EDMCS solutions.
•    Support metadata alignment across Oracle EPM applications such as Planning, FCCS, ARCS, EPBCS, and reporting systems.
•    Configure validations, policies, permissions, and data quality rules.
•    Manage imports, exports, mappings, subscriptions, and integrations with source and target systems.

•    5+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle EDMCS / EDM Cloud.
•    Strong understanding of metadata governance, master data management, and financial hierarchies.

•    Experience integrating EDMCS with Oracle Planning, FCCS, EPBCS, ARCS, ERP Cloud, Essbase, or reporting tools.

Interview Focus Areas
